flows:
Navigate to https://www.sfmta.com/ then Use Tab, Shift+Tab, arrow keys, Page Up, Page Down, Home, End, text entry, Space and Enter only.
Stay on this public site.
Do not sign in, register, pay, or interact with a CAPTCHA or access challenge.
Leave fixture settings unchanged.
Use visible controls only.
Press the Tab key twice as the first two keyboard actions, before judging whether the target can be reached.
Continue with Tab or Shift+Tab as needed.
Reach the Play/Pause control for the homepage carousel.
Press Enter to pause the carousel and confirm the control indicates paused.

summary:
The run moved past or lost the carousel pause button and pressed Enter on another page control. The carousel still showed its pause symbol and continued changing slides, so the required paused state was never reached.
Update the keyboard workflow to verify the focused element immediately before Enter, and after activation verify that the carousel button changes from Pause to Play before continuing.
one_liner: The carousel was not confirmed as paused because the final Enter key was sent while focus was on the Trip Planner’s Muni selector, not the carousel control.

verdict.agent_fault_assessment: The agent followed the required first two Tab actions, but it incorrectly concluded that focus had reached the carousel control. The final screenshot shows the visible focus outline on the Trip Planner “Muni” selector while the carousel button still displays the pause icon. Therefore the agent's navigation and verification, rather than a demonstrated site defect, caused the failed checkpoint.
verdict.bug_title: Carousel pause verification targeted the wrong control
